'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[November 2024 Moscow drone attack]]
****One person is injured and at least 36 flights are diverted when 34 [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Drone warfare|drones strike]] [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/russia-ukraine-drones-moscow-1.7379721 (CBC News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 40 people are killed in [[Israel]]i airstrikes across the [[Gaza Strip]], including at least 24 in the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] in [[North Gaza Governorate]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] claims they killed a top [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] commander in the strikes.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dozens-killed-wounded-israeli-strike-northern-gazas-jabalia-medics-say-2024-11-10/ (Reuters)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-says-palestinian-islamic-jihad-operations-head-killed-in-gaza-strike/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/11/10/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-iran-news-11-10-2024/0ea59804-9f42-11ef-b90e-a2320192900f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
***An Israeli airstrike on a house in [[Gaza City]] kills Wael al-Khour, a minister in the [[Hamas]]-run government, along with his wife and their three children. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israeli-strikes-kill-dozens-lebanon-isolated-northern-gaza-officials-s-rcna179490 (NBC News)]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
*** [[Qatar]] withdraws from ceasefire talks between [[Hamas]] and [[Israel]] as mediator due to "a refusal to negotiate a deal in good faith" from Hamas and Israel. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/09/middleeast/qatar-mediation-israel-hamas-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-war-lebanon-hezbollah-11-09-2024-e97ca8ab4ac8151281bab6895bb04404 (''AP'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/09/hamas-may-have-to-quit-political-base-in-qatar-after-us-demand (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***An [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] in the village of Aalmat, [[Byblos District]], [[Lebanon]], kills at least 23 people, including seven children, and injures six others. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-iran-news-11-10-2024-aa1a248a1afccf5eefc471323f764e96 (AP)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Ten people are killed and seven others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a bar in [[Querétaro (city)|Querétaro]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/gunmen-mexico-shooting-bar-queretaro-cartel-violence/ (CBS News)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Five [[Basij]] officers are killed after a shooting by suspected [[Jaish ul-Adl]] gunmen in [[Saravan, Iran|Saravan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-basij-guard-militant-baluch-pakistan-border-0e06d1064aee776722edc89a0911ed19 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A {{M|ww|link=y}} 6.8 [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Bartolomé Masó, Cuba|Bartolomé Masó]], [[Cuba]], causing [[landslide]]s and damage to buildings in the region.  [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/10/americas/earthquake-cuba-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[November 2024 Amsterdam attacks]]
***More than 300 pro-Palestinian protesters are forcibly removed and 50 others are detained by [[Dutch police]] for participating in a rally in [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]], in violation of a ban on demonstrations that was implemented following the attacks on [[Maccabi Tel Aviv F.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]] fans on Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dutch-police-halt-pro-palestinian-rally-after-soccer-violence-2024-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tuskegee University shooting]]
**One person is killed and 16 others are injured in a [[school shooting]] during a homecoming weekend party at [[Tuskegee University]] in [[Tuskegee, Alabama|Tuskegee]], [[Alabama]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/1-dead-several-injured-tuskegee-university-homecoming-weekend-shooting-rcna179493 (NBC News)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2024 Mauritian general election]]
**Citizens of [[Mauritius]] vote for the 66 seats of the [[National Assembly of Mauritius|National Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mauritius-holds-election-with-cost-living-everyones-minds-2024-11-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**[[Ahmed Mohamed Islam|Ahmed Madobe]], the [[List of presidents of Jubaland|President]] of the state of [[Jubaland]], [[Somalia]], appoints a regional electoral committee, with Somalia's [[Ministry of Interior and Federal Affairs (Somalia)|Interior Ministry]] calling the committee unauthorized and urging [[Somali clans|clans]] to fight for their rights. Jubaland subsequently suspends relations with the [[Federal Government of Somalia|federal government]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-hassan-sheikh-rejects-jubaland-election-model-he-endorsed-during-farmajo-era (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Nov/198867/jubbaland_suspends_cooperation_with_federal_government_citing_constitutional_violations.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*Members of the [[Jamaat-e-Islami]] party announce that they have prevented former [[Bangladesh]] [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] and the [[Awami League]] party from holding a rally in [[Dhaka]], Bangladesh, to commemorate [[Noor Hossain Day]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-sheikh-hasina-khaleda-zia-muhammad-yunus-3e022c6bd6939bb13f0e93e49781268f (AP)]
